metadata.scenario: An individual new to the area calls to ask about the types of memberships available at the local gym. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, my name is Agnes Rodriguez. I’m new to the area and have some questions. Welcome, Agnes! What questions do you have for us? I'm curious about the types of memberships available at the local gym. I’m sorry, but we’re a home healthcare agency, not a gym. Oh, I see! I must have called the wrong place. No problem! We do offer a variety of healthcare services if that interests you. Actually, I could use some help. I’m looking for companionship services. We offer companion care, which includes social interaction and light housekeeping. That sounds perfect! Can you tell me more about the costs? Sure! Our companion care service is priced at $25 to $30 per hour. That seems reasonable. How do I set that up? I can help you with that. Are you looking for regular visits or occasional ones? Ideally, I’d like someone to come regularly, maybe a few times a week. Great! We can set up a care plan that fits your needs. That would be helpful. Do you have any caregivers available? Yes, we can match you with a caregiver based on your preferences. I’d like someone who enjoys gardening, if possible. We can definitely find someone who shares that interest! Wonderful! What other services do you offer? We also provide skilled nursing care, physical therapy, and medication management. That’s good to know! I might need that in the future. Absolutely! Is there anything else you’d like to discuss today? No, just how soon I can start with companion care. We can usually get a caregiver started within a few days. Perfect! How do I proceed with the paperwork? I can connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, for that. That sounds great! What number can I reach her at? You can reach Lisa at +13165559203, extension 203. Thank you! I appreciate your help today. You’re welcome, Agnes! We look forward to helping you. I’ll call Lisa shortly. Have a great day! You too! Take care.
